points.description: States that the connection must be full-duplex (or semi-duplex/half-duplex), i.e. two-way communication in which both sender and receiver send data frames.
points.partial_credit: Only says 'two-way communication' or 'data flows both directions' without naming duplex: 0.25

points.description: States that data frames must contain an additional field for the acknowledgement (ACK number), so that the acknowledgement can be carried in an outgoing data frame instead of a separate ACK frame.
points.partial_credit: Says acknowledgements are attached to/sent with data frames but does not state a frame field is needed: 0.25

rubric.notes: Full marks need both: the duplex (two-way) connection, named precisely, and the extra acknowledgement field in data frames. Part marks only for a clear but imprecise version of one element, e.g. 'two-way communication' without the duplex term. A wrong statement, such as requiring simplex, or a vague answer like 'needs sliding window' earns nothing for that point.
